segments.refined_text: The rough consensus algorithm is not used for payment authorization. I want that sentence unchanged if it appears in the final transcript because it is specifically distinguishing Raft from the ledger's transaction protocol.
For load testing, the target is 1,240 requests per second with 40 percent reads and 60 percent writes. The test duration is 20 minutes.
We expect the Kafka consumer lag to remain below 500 messages under normal load. If lag exceeds 2,000 for more than 5 minutes, the load test should be considered failed.
The failure-injection test will stop one Kafka broker and one application replica. We are not planning to stop two brokers simultaneously in this test.
We might schedule the production canary for the 15th, but that date is tentative. The release manager has not approved it yet.
